add_drop: Courses may be added or dropped through the tenth instructional day.
attendance: Instructors publish attendance expectations in each course syllabus.
bicycles: Bicycles must use outdoor racks and may not block accessible entrances.
exam_conflict: Students with three final exams in one day may request an alternate time.
food_lab: Food and open drinks are not allowed in teaching laboratories.
guest_wifi: Visitors may request a 24-hour guest network pass from the help desk.
library_hours: The fictional campus library is open from 8:00 to 22:00 on weekdays.
quiet_hours: Residence hall quiet hours begin at 22:00 Sunday through Thursday and midnight Friday and Saturday.
